authority.allowed_compute: local CPU and already-persisted artifacts only

research_contract.target: Determine whether pre-existing Barcarolle Task-selection rules produce a ten-Task benchmark whose two-Agent pass rates predict the next five chronological Tasks better than predeclared baselines.
research_contract.operational_definition: Closeness is lower future_pass_rate_mae: the mean across the two frozen Agents of the absolute difference between selected-history and future-cohort pass rate.
research_contract.population: The fixed 75-Task certified SymPy SWE-bench Verified source slice and its historical task_material_available_at ordering.
research_contract.primary_claim_scope: Retrospective counterfactual replay conditional on this source slice, the two frozen Agent identities, base replicate zero, duration strata, and the frozen protocol.
excluded_claims: generalization to another repository, Generator, harness, model, or endpoint period
semantic similarity to a target developer population
a universal best Selector or tuned production default
insufficient_evidence_conditions: fewer than eight complete non-overlapping future blocks
a source digest or core record binding does not replay
any primary Selection uses a post-origin feature or outcome
future Result evidence differs between Selectors at the same Origin
the core metric and independent recomputation disagree

rolling_origin.dependency_policy: Allow realistic patch-path cluster recurrence in the primary replay; report overlap and run a first-task-per-cluster sensitivity.

primary.supported_rule: Mean difference is at most -0.02 and the paired 95% origin-block bootstrap upper bound is below zero.
primary.inconclusive_rule: Mean difference is negative but either practical or interval criterion is not met.
primary.not_supported_rule: Mean difference is zero or positive.

adaptive_secondary.role: supporting, not a substitute for the primary contrast

stratified_parameter_grid.interpretation: exploratory stability only; no best grid point becomes a confirmatory or production default

repeat_noise_views.method: For each Agent by replicated Task, draw one available scoreable persisted replicate; keep base replicate zero for non-replicated Tasks.

sensitivity_analyses.dependency: Repeat the transparent fixed-rule analysis on the earliest Task in each dependency cluster, using 14 initial Tasks and eight non-overlapping five-Task future blocks.

diagnostics.hindsight_outcome_subset_oracle: Enumerate feasible counts of the four joint Agent outcome categories for a ten-Task history subset.
diagnostics.composition: Report forecast/future total-variation error, cap activation, maximum weight, and effective sample size.

approach_registry.decisive_test: Selections replay through public Selection APIs and metrics through the ordinary ResultMatrix/evaluate_selection path.
A direct task/outcome implementation exactly matches every core primary MAE and selection membership.
Quantify repeat sensitivity, dependency sensitivity, hindsight headroom, and the prospective evidence scale needed to resolve the observed effect.
